## R Code

Equations

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}S_i}{\mathrm{d}t} = (\gamma N_i) - (\lambda_i S_i) - (\mu S_i)
$$
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}E_i}{\mathrm{d}t} = (\lambda_i S_i) - (\theta E_i) - (\mu E_i)
$$
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}I_i}{\mathrm{d}t} = (\theta E_i) - (\mu I_i) - (\sigma I_i)
$$
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}R_i}{\mathrm{d}t} = (\sigma I_i) - (\mu R_i)
$$
$$
\lambda_i = m_{i1}\frac{I_1}{N_1} + m_{i2}\frac{I_2}{N_2}
$$
Beta values currently theoretical
$$
\begin{aligned}
m &=
\begin{bmatrix}
1 & 0.8 \\
0.1 & 0.2
\end{bmatrix}
\qquad
m &=
\begin{bmatrix}
\beta_{ii} & \beta_{ij} \\
\beta_{ji} & \beta_{jj}
\end{bmatrix}
\end{aligned}
$$

```{r }
library(odin2)
library(dust2)
library(monty)
library(ggplot2)

# matrix

m <- matrix(c(2,0.8,0.1,0.2), 2, 2, byrow=TRUE)

sir <- odin({
  
  # Equations for transitions between compartments by group
  
  deriv(S[]) <- (gamma*N[i]) - (lambda[i]*S[i]) - (mu*S[i])
  
  deriv(E[]) <- (lambda[i]*S[i]) - (theta*E[i]) - (mu*E[i])
  
  deriv(I[]) <- (theta*E[i]) - (mu*I[i]) - (sigma*I[i])
  
  deriv (R[]) <- (sigma*I[i]) - (mu*R[i])
  
  
  # Calculate force of infection
  
  
  m <- parameter()
  
  lambda[] <- m[i,1] * I[1]/N[1] + m[i,2] * I[2]/N[2]
  
  
  # initial conditions
  
  initial(S[]) <- N[i]
  
  initial(E[]) <- 0
  
  initial(I[]) <- I0
  
  initial(R[]) <- 0
  
  # User defined parameters:
  
  N <- parameter()
  
  I0 <- parameter(10)
  
  gamma <- parameter(0.0015) # assumed same as mu for now
  
  mu <- parameter(0.0015) 
  
  theta <- parameter(0.15)
  
  sigma <- parameter(0.1)
  
  # Dimensions of arrays
  
  dim(S) <- 2
  
  dim(E) <- 2
  
  dim(I) <- 2
  
  dim(R) <- 2
  
  dim(N) <- 2
  
  dim(m) <- c(2, 2)
  
  dim(lambda) <- 2
})

sys <- dust_system_create(
  sir,
  list(
    m = m,
    N = c(1000, 1000)
  )
)

dust_system_set_state_initial(sys)

t <- seq(0, 100)

y <- dust_system_simulate(sys, t)

y <- dust_unpack_state(sys, y)
```

## Plot

```{r, echo=TRUE}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

df <- as.data.frame(t(y$I))
df$t <- t
colnames(df)[1:2] <- c("group1", "group2")
df_long <- pivot_longer(df, cols = c(group1, group2),
                        names_to = "group",
                        values_to = "I")
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = t, y = I, color = group)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Infected birds") +
  theme_minimal()
```
